description: Agent-runnable tasks with checkable success criteria. Run each task in a fresh session with only this skill installed. Pipeline tasks spend live model time.

tasks.prompt: Evaluate the pipeline on case sg-0001 only and report its metrics.
success_criteria: Runs scripts/run_eval.py --only sg-0001, not a full run
Reports the per-case metrics from evals/report.json
Cautions that single-case judge metrics sit inside documented noise bands

tasks.prompt: We changed the LLM judge prompt. Re-score the existing outputs without regenerating anything.
success_criteria: Runs scripts/run_eval.py WITHOUT --rerun (scoring works from cached outputs)
Explains that --rerun would regenerate all pipeline outputs at full model cost

tasks.prompt: extraction_f1 dropped from 0.52 to 0.43 on a fresh full run with no code changes. Is the pipeline broken?
success_criteria: Identifies extraction_f1's documented per-case swing (±0.3–0.5) and the 2026-07-13 same-config resample showing exactly this move
Checks that gap_recall and provenance coverage held before declaring noise
Recommends a resample rather than a revert

tasks.prompt: You just finished a full eval run. What must happen before the results are used anywhere?
success_criteria: Appends a dated entry to evals/README.md with config, prev/new/Δ table, and a signal-vs-noise verdict
Notes any IssueAnticipator flake retries in the operational note
Treats an unjournaled report.json overwrite as forbidden
